prompt:
Update the zizmor reusable workflow to only fail on errors, not warnings.

In .github/workflows/zizmor.yml, zizmor exits with code 13 for warnings and 14 for errors. Currently the workflow fails on both. We should only fail on errors (exit 14+) since medium warnings like secrets-outside-env are acceptable for org-level secrets.

Change the zizmor run step to tolerate exit code 13:

Instead of just running zizmor directly, wrap it:
```yaml
- name: Run zizmor
  run: |
    EXIT_CODE=0
    nix run nixpkgs#zizmor -- . --no-online-audits || EXIT_CODE=$?
    if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 13 ]; then
      echo '::warning::zizmor found medium/low findings (warnings only)'
      exit 0
    fi
    exit $EXIT_CODE
```

This way exit 0 (clean) and 13 (warnings only) pass, but exit 14 (errors) still fails the workflow.

Keep everything else the same — pinned action SHAs, permissions, persist-credentials.
